name: Kimi no Tonari ni Suwaru Hoshi.
source:
One day, a sparkling door opens before you—a door that leads to the world of stars.
It is on the other side that you find yourself face to face with twelve unique, vibrant princes, as well as their caretaker, a man whose face seems sculpted by the gods. The caretaker goes down on one knee before you and implores:

"Epilogia—the king's oracle. I beg you to lend us your strength and break us free from our doomed fate."

The king of the cosmos has gone missing, and make no mistake—it is YOUR destiny to select a new king and guide him to prosperity.

Now you must spend your days among the princes, building deep and bountiful bonds with them. Come be the light that will illuminate their path to a bright, shining future!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.nowpro.str]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
有一天，一扇闪闪发光的门在你面前打开——一扇通往星空世界的门。
在另一边，你会发现自己与十二位独特、充满活力的王子以及他们的看护者面对面，他的脸似乎是由众神雕刻而成的。看门人在你面前单膝跪下恳求：

“Epilogia——国王的神谕。我请求你借给我们力量，让我们摆脱注定的命运。”

宇宙之王失踪了，毫无疑问，你的命运就是选择一位新国王并引导他走向繁荣。

现在你必须和王子们一起度过日子，与他们建立深厚而丰富的联系。成为一盏明灯，照亮他们通向光明未来的道路！

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.nowpro.str]Google Play[/url]]
